messages:
Aly: Pet-photo parade! Drop a pic + one-line 'meet-the-pet' and I'll start the cookie-jar pick. Prize = one (1) slightly mysterious biscotti. :cookie:
Marco: OK here's Mochi (pic) — 'professional napper, 3am alarm snoozer' :heart_eyes: 
Jai: @Aly submitting my cat's resume: 'skills: sits on laptop, interrupts standups, steals pens' :joy: 
Sam: Doggo entry: 'Rex — CEO of shoes' (pic) :dog: 
ops-bot: Reminder: kitchen cookies expire in 3 days — please label any "for team" boxes. :robot_face: 
Lina: Quick poll — react with :one: for Mochi, :two: for Rex. 
Aly: Tiny haiku for Mochi: 'Sunbeam on the rug / Paws knead dreams into the floor / Nap meets the overtime' :sparkles: 
Marco: I vote Mochi but also shocked Rex hasn't chewed a headphone yet. :headphones: 
Jai: :one: Mochi forever. 
Sam: :two: cause dogs bring snacks. 
Lina: Tally so far: Mochi 1, Rex 1 — tie breaker needed. coinflip? 
Aly: Coinflip then — heads Mochi, tails Rex. flipping... :coin: 
Marco: Heads! (it landed on the edge) :astonished: 
Jai: Amazing. Tie persists. We must escalate to bagels. 
Sam: Deploying tie-breaker: whoever brings cookies next week wins. :cookie: 
Aly: Deal. Also — who cleaned the microwave earlier? Mystery hero deserves a sticker. 
Lina: That was @Jai — saw them with gloves. :raised_hands: 
Jai: Guilty. But only because I nuked my lunch into volcanic status. 
ops-bot: :white_check_mark: Kitchen cleanliness note logged. 
Aly: OK thread wrap — stash pet pics in #random-pets channel too. Thanks team! :tada:
